text:
Jesperi Kotkaniemi went home for the Global Series in Finland this month, and NHL.com followed him through it, from the open practice to the family visits. His season in Carolina has been a pleasant surprise too: 5 goals and 11 points in 19 games on under 12 minutes a night, already past last season's 9 points in 42 games.

It won't keep going at this rate. He's shooting 25% after 5% last season, with five goals on 1.9 expected, and the Hurricanes have scored about five and a half more goals than expected with him on the ice. Our numbers flag him as due to cool, and the five-on-five picture agrees: Carolina is almost six points better by expected goal share (the quality of chances) when he sits.

That's not new. Evolving-Hockey had his team's chance creation in the bottom 1% of forwards with him on the ice last season, even with strong linemates. He's a third- or fourth-line center on a Cup winner, and his job is minutes, not offense. Enjoy the goals, and watch whether his ice time drops when they stop.
